text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Well then, until next time.

On the way back from shopping for supplies.
As if her business was done, she walks away.
choice_data_list: (...Maybe I'll take a walk before heading back.)
(...Maybe I'll take a walk before heading home.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, haaah...
...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I knew it... this is nice.
No matter how far I run, it's just me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Nobody's here... Nobody knows.
...A place just for me...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Surrendering myself to the serene air, listening to the rustling leaves, forgetting about time...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Time alone—)
...Oh, hello.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
!
Ayabe-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "You're here too, huh. This field is so wide... I didn't notice you."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (I wasn't the only one.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Don't worry, I'll be heading back soon.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You came here to spend time alone, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Well now.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It really is quiet and relaxing here.
Hardly anyone ever comes by.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Nothing to bother or trouble me either.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Times like that are important, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Lost in thought, or just running non-stop—
this place is the best for relaxing by myself.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Besides... the stars are beautiful at night.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: There aren't any buildings around here, so you can see far into the distance, right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It is magnificent. ...Very much so.
Venturing out a bit farther while taking a walk, I ended up witnessing an unexpected sight.
choice_data_list: (They both seem to have such a gentle vibe...)

text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps as fellow introverts,
we can talk with peace of mind...
I found myself feeling a bit relieved."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Groove-san.
...Do you always come at this time?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
Um, Ayabe-senpai is...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Usually, it's about an hour before.
I had an errand today, so my timing was thrown off.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Also... on days off, at night to gaze at the stars.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I see... In that case,

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

Will a friendship blossom from this?
As a Trainer, that's truly wonderful to see.

text_block_list.name: Alv & Ayabe
text_block_list.text: Next time, at a time that doesn't overlap.
choice_data_list: How did it end up like this!?
How does it end up like that!?
(Ah, so it went in that direction~)

text_block_list.name: Alv & Ayabe
text_block_list.text: Next time, at a time that doesn't overlap.
choice_data_list: How did it end up like this!?
How does it end up like that!?
(Ah, so it went in that direction~)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Were you watching?
choice_data_list: Ah, I just happened to be passing by, that's all!
Yeah, but I just happened to be passing by!

text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly explained
that I certainly hadn't followed her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I am aware.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll take my leave.
choice_data_list: (So no bond blossomed after all, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It seems something unnecessary
is on your mind.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Time alone is nice. ...For both of us.

She was unwavering to the very end—
and seeing that brought a fond smile to my face.
Normally, this might develop into hanging out together next time, or stargazing just the two of us, but—
choice_data_list: (I guess when you're both on your own, it doesn't turn out like that, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Well then.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

The two part ways as if nothing had happened.
There is even a sense of refreshing clarity in the way they look.
choice_data_list: (Well, I guess that's just like her...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ......Yeah, looks good.

So as not to disturb her alone time,
I quietly left the scene.
